title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 26, 2026

A newly reported CME has Sunny checking in on the outer corona.

☀️ CME start: September 26, 2026 at 00:48 UTC
💨 CME speed: 478 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: S-type (<500 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 15° (Narrow)
🌎 WSA-ENLIL Earth outlook: No or little Earth impact modeled

Sunny is watching the corona. 👀🌌

Image: NOAA SWPC — LASCO C2
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
